title: Too small for average food storage
text:
Too small for average food storage. This is one of those times when I really should have read the description a little bit better. I bought these so that I could leftovers in different sections instead of using more than one container. These containers are super small. Like super small. And while they do have a divider in them, it is only because two smaller plastic inserts fit into the bigger item to create the separation. I figured I would use these to store small items in, like nails, but even nails 1.75 inches are pretty much too big for the container. I'm not sure exactly how I am going to end up using these, but hopefully I find a use for them.
Just be aware that these are small, very small, and wouldn't really work for most food storage.
